title: 太陽與地球
lyrics:
想守護你所有
回應你包容的溫柔
想用盡一生 陪在你左右是我

短暫如煙火 在懷裡墜落
奔向了星空 到不了心中

誰要我們的心 遙遠得像太陽與地球
怎會走到最後 你愛著我卻不屬於我
誰要時間奔走 只能照耀再不能觸碰
最靠近的我們 怎麼繞著繞著就錯過

在偌大銀河中
沒想過像流星交錯
該怎麼原諒讓你哭的人是我
抱歉沒有機會說

最渴望的夢 是你在等我
轟烈在星空 消散在心中
最難忘的人 是永恆地錯過

誰要我們的心 遙遠得像太陽與地球
怎會走到最後 你愛著我卻不屬於我
誰要時間奔走 只能照耀再不能觸碰
最靠近的我們  怎麼繞著繞著各自走

人總要狠狠痛過
才懂我要什麼
捨不得你不再快樂
如果悲傷請你留給我

原來我們的心  頑固地像太陽與地球
以為徹底分開 徹底放手 不曾離開過
我們只是錯過  誰都沒錯都努力愛過
最遙遠的我們  別回頭往幸福一直走

lyrics_en2:
I want to protect all of you,  
Responding to your gentle tolerance.  
I want to spend my whole life  
By your side—  
A dream of dawn and dusk’s glow.  

Brief as fireworks, falling into my embrace,  
Running towards the starry sky but unable to reach my heart.  
What reason is there  
That forces me to let go?  

Who wants our hearts,  
So distant like the sun and the earth?  
How could it end this way—  
You love me but don’t belong to me?  
Who wants time to rush by,  
Only able to shine but never touch?  
We, so close,  
How did we circle around and miss each other?  

In this vast galaxy,  
Never thought like shooting stars crossing paths,  
How could I forgive that the one who made you cry is me?  
Sorry, I never had the chance to say.  

The most longing dream is you waiting for me,  
Burning fiercely in the starry sky, fading within my heart.  
The most unforgettable person is the eternal miss.  

Who wants our hearts,  
So distant like the sun and the earth?  
How could it end this way—  
You love me but don’t belong to me?  
Who wants time to rush by,  
Only able to shine but never touch?  
We, so close,  
How did we circle around and walk apart?  

People must suffer deeply,  
To understand what they truly want.  
Reluctant to see you no longer happy,  
If there’s sorrow, please leave it to me.  

It turns out our hearts  
Are stubborn like the sun and the earth.  
Thinking that complete separation, complete letting go,  
Never truly meant leaving.  
We just missed each other,  
No one’s wrong, we both loved earnestly.  
Our most distant selves—  
Don’t look back, keep walking toward happiness.
